name_en: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme - Tamil Nadu
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: You get Rs 1,200 every month (raised from Rs 1,000 in August 2023). It stays Rs 1,200 at age 80 and above. You also get a free saree or dhoti at Pongal and Deepavali, and free rice at the Anganwadi centre.

other: You must be destitute (no one to support you).
Your family must be in the Below Poverty Line (BPL) group.

documents: Smart ration card or any address proof
Any ID proof (voter ID, passport, PAN card or driving licence)
how_to_apply: Get copies of your papers. Go to the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC). Give your fingerprint there. Fill the form and upload your papers. Ask for a receipt.

gaps: The myScheme 'Details' paragraph wrongly names this scheme 'The Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme' (copy error on the page); the page title and eligibility are for old age pension.
Source does not give a rupee income limit; it only says Below Poverty Line.
No helpline or G.O. number in the source.
The myScheme page still says Rs 1,000 a month; the official Revenue Administration page (Rs 1,200 from August 2023) is newer and is used.

Of the Rs 1,200, the Centre pays Rs 200 and the State Rs 1,000 for ages 60 to 79; the Centre Rs 500 and the State Rs 700 at 80 and above (Revenue Administration page). A separate report said Rs 1,500 at 80 and above; the official page does not support that.

review.note: Amount confirmed on the official Revenue Administration page: Rs 1,200 a month from August 2023, the same at 80 and above. Eligibility (destitute, Below Poverty Line) still has to be checked for each person.
